units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:7">Targ. Gen. II, 7</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Bets. II, end, 62ᵇ (<cite ref="L00000"><he>ל</he></cite>) <he>מִנְפּוֹחַ וכ׳</he> to blow meat up.
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:13">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>לִינְפַּח ליה חבריה וכ׳</he> let his neighbor blow white cress-seeds (into his throat) through a straw.
Ḥull. 46ᵇ ונַפְחִינָא לה and we blow the lungs up; a. fr.—Part. pass. נְפִיחַ; f. נְפִיחָא; pl. נְפִיחִין; נְפִיחָן blown, ignited; blown up, swollen.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 20:26">Targ. Job XX, 26</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 5:21">Targ. O. Num. V, 21</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chullin 47b:2">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>א״ד דנפיחא</he> (not <he>דנפיחה</he>) some explain <he>דמיא לאופתא</he> (v. <cite ref="A00818"><he>אוּפְתָּא</he></cite>) as meaning lungs which look as if distended (white).
<cite ref="Shabbat 33a:12">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>נְפִיחֵי כפן</he>, v. <cite ref="K01035"><he>כַּפְנָא</he></cite>; a. fr.
Targ. O. Num. V, 27, v. Ithpa. (Y. ותְנָפַח, prob. to be read: ותִתְנְפַח).—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33:6">Lev. R. s. 33</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00372"><he>קוּלְתָא</he></cite>.
Targ. Y. Num. V, 22 (O. לְאַפָּחָא, Af.; ed. Amst. לַאֲפָחָא); a. e.—Part. pass. מְנַפַּח; f. מְנַפְּחָא; pl. מְנַפְּחִין; מְנַפְּחָן. Targ. Y. ib. 21.—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד כות׳</he> 1) <he>כל עמא מְנַפְּחִין לי וכ׳</he> (I dreamt) all the people were blowing at me with their full cheeks.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>דאינון מנפחין</he> (it meant) that it (the wheat) was swollen (through rain drippings).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 43a:11">Snh. 43ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 134b:8">B. Bath. 134ᵇ</cite> <he>מְנַפֵּח רב ששת וכ׳</he> R. Sh. blew into his hand (intimating that the question raised was scurrilous); a. e.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 5:22">Targ. O. Num. V, 22</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 11:6">Targ. Ps. XI, 6</cite> <he>מַפְּחִין דאשתא</he> (Ms. <he>מפ׳ אש׳</he>) blowers (winds) of fire (h. text <he>פחים אש</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 31:39">Targ. Job XXXI, 39</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 2:33">Targ. I Sam. II, 33</cite> (h. text <he>לאדיב</he>).—V. <cite ref="M02203"><he>מַפַּח</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 5:27">Targ. Y. Num. V, 27</cite> (v. supra; O. <he>ויִפְּחוּן</he>, ed. Berl. <he>ויִפְחוּן</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 19:26">Targ. Job XIX, 26</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="N01026"><he>אִתְּפָח</he></cite>; h. text <he>נקפו</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 12:5">Targ. Koh. XII, 5</cite>.—Y. Maas. Sh. IV, end, 55ᶜ <he>אִינַּפְּחָן</he> the wheat shall swell (v. supra).
<cite ref="Shabbat 26a:2">Sabb. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>אינפח בה נורא</he> she caught fire.
